configuration: Trusted startup calls permissionbundle.Install(context, Store, CatalogPin, NativeFactSource) before constructing modules; no model/request/environment activation or default catalog.

facts.authentication: authenticated bf_ User Bot, exact own key, current SQL scope, existing Bot limiter
facts.semantics: Source supplies actual native/SQL facts at declared native cuts. Server validates closed frames and correlation, never invocation/capability verdicts. A protocol fixture is not native authority.

association_commit.begin: BeginAssociation(config.Context, dbr.Session): fresh RR and one native-transaction deadline when installed
association_commit.commit: CommitAssociations(context, tx, Association...): native guards for all supplied scopes, sorted final header suffix, commit then authority acknowledgement
association_commit.new: true only for an actual newly inserted association; existing/reopened membership requires its preserved header
association_commit.unsupported: human, built-in and legacy-token association creates no supported User Bot header

default_composition: permission routes absent until required real dependencies are installed
